title: Combining Sentences
ringkas: Kalimat majemuk, klausa, dan variasi kalimat
goals: menggabungkan kalimat pendek dengan **and, but, or, so, because**
memakai **although, when, while, if** untuk kalimat kompleks
memakai **who, which, that** untuk menambah informasi
menghindari **kalimat yang bertele-tele atau terlalu pendek berulang**

lesson.text: Tulisan yang baik memakai kalimat dengan **panjang yang bervariasi**. Kalimat pendek yang berulang terasa kaku. Dengan kata penghubung, kamu menggabungkan gagasan dan membuat tulisan mengalir.

lesson.title: 1. Penghubung dasar
table: [[I like tea, and my sister likes coffee.]]
[[I like tea, but I do not like coffee.]]
[[It was raining, so we stayed home.]]
[[We stayed home because it was raining.]]

lesson.title: 2. Penghubung klausa dan klausa relatif
table: [[Although it was late, we kept working.]]
[[The girl who sits next to me is Dina.]]
[[The book that I bought is interesting.]]

examples.en: [[Rani is a student. She studies hard. → Rani is a student who studies hard.]]
examples.id: Rani seorang siswa. Dia belajar giat. → Rani seorang siswa yang belajar giat.

lesson.title: Jangan memakai dua penghubung berlawanan
lesson.text: Salah: *Although it was late, but we kept working.* Benar: [[Although it was late, we kept working.]] atau [[It was late, but we kept working.]]

lesson.title: Variasi
lesson.text: Dalam satu paragraf, campurkan kalimat pendek, sedang, dan panjang. Mulai beberapa kalimat dengan penghubung (*Although*, *When*, *Because*).

items: who, which, that menambah informasi tentang benda atau orang.
Jangan pakai although dan but bersama.

practice.q: Gabungkan dengan "because": "I was late. The bus broke down."
options: I was late because the bus broke down.
I was late because the bus broke down, and.
I was late so the bus broke down.
Because I was late the bus broke down.

practice.q: Gabungkan dengan "so": "It was hot. We went swimming."
options: It was hot, so we went swimming.
It was hot because we went swimming.
It was hot, but we went swimming.
It was hot so that went swimming.
practice.exp: So + akibat. Jawaban yang tepat: **It was hot, so we went swimming.**

practice.q: Gabungkan dengan "but": "I like tea. I don't like coffee."
options: I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
I like tea, so I don't like coffee.
I like tea because I don't like coffee.
I like tea or I don't like coffee.

practice.q: Gabungkan dengan "although": "It was raining. We played outside."
options: Although it was raining, we played outside.
Although it was raining, but we played outside.
It was raining although, we played outside.
Although we played outside, it was raining, but.

practice.q: Gabungkan dengan "who": "I have a friend. She speaks four languages."
options: I have a friend who speaks four languages.
I have a friend which speaks four languages.
I have a friend, she speaks four languages who.
I have a friend whose speaks four languages.
practice.exp: Orang → who. Jawaban yang tepat: **I have a friend who speaks four languages.**

practice.q: Gabungkan dengan "that": "I read a book. It was very long."
options: I read a book that was very long.
I read a book who was very long.
I read a book, it was very long that.
I read a book what was very long.

practice.q: Gabungkan dengan "when": "I got home. It started to rain."
options: When I got home, it started to rain.
When I got home it started rain to.
I got home when, it started to rain.
When it started to rain, I got home it.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang paling baik:
options: Although he was tired, he finished the report.
He was tired. He finished the report. He was tired.
Although he was tired, but he finished the report.
He finished the report tired was he.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang SALAH:
options: Although it was cold, but we went out.
Although it was cold, we went out.
It was cold, but we went out.
We went out although it was cold.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang SALAH:
options: The man which lives next door is a doctor.
The man who lives next door is a doctor.
The book that I bought is good.
The girl who sings is my sister.
practice.exp: Orang → who. Jawaban yang tepat: **The man which lives next door is a doctor.**

Susun kalimat: "Walaupun hujan, kami bermain di luar."
practice.answer: Although it was raining, we played outside.
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: Although it was raining, we played outside.

practice.answer: I like tea, but I don't like coffee.

practice.q: Susun kalimat: "Kami tinggal di rumah karena hujan."

practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: We stayed home because it was raining.

practice.q: Susun kalimat: "Ketika aku tiba, dia sedang tidur."

practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: When I arrived, he was sleeping.

quiz.q: Gabungkan dengan "because": "She was happy. She passed the test."
options: She was happy because she passed the test.
She was happy so she passed the test.
She was happy but she passed the test.
She was happy although she passed the test.

quiz.q: Gabungkan dengan "so": "I was hungry. I ate a sandwich."
options: I was hungry, so I ate a sandwich.
I was hungry because I ate a sandwich.
I was hungry, but I ate a sandwich.
I was hungry or I ate a sandwich.
quiz.exp: So. Jawaban yang tepat: **I was hungry, so I ate a sandwich.**

Although came to school, he was ill.
quiz.exp: Although. Jawaban yang tepat: **Although he was ill, he came to school.**
